question: Combine Section 3.5 and Figure G.4-1: what technology-development work is completed in Phase B, and what does TRL 6 demonstrate and in what environment?

function.name: search
function.arguments: {"query":"Phase B technology development TRL 6 Figure G.4-1"}

message.content: {"status":"answered","claims":[{"text":"In Phase B, technology development work includes defining the project in enough detail to establish an initial baseline capable of meeting mission needs, developing system structure end product requirements, generating preliminary designs, performing analyses and engineering development tests, conducting human systems integration assessments, selecting preliminary design solutions, developing operations plans, reporting technology development results, updating cost and schedule data, improving fidelity of models and prototypes, identifying and updating risks, and developing preliminary plans such as orbital debris assessment, decommissioning, and disposal plans.","citations":[{"page":26,"bbox":[0.05,0.05,0.95,0.95],"locator":"Section 3.5 Project Phase B: Preliminary Design and Technology Completion"}]},{"text":"TRL 6 demonstrates a system or subsystem model or prototype demonstration in a relevant environment, which can be ground or space.","citations":[{"page":211,"bbox":[0.05,0.3,0.95,0.6],"locator":"Figure G.4-1 Technology Readiness Levels"}]}]}

 Technical support of the system design, product realization, and technical management
 Assessment efforts. This includes developing technical assessment strategies and policies,

 SE 3.8 Evaluating technical decision issues, identifying decision criteria, identifying
 Technical alternatives, analyzing alternatives, and selecting alternatives. Performed throughout
 Decision the system life cycle to formulate candidate decision alternatives, and evaluate
 Analysis their impacts on health and safety, technical, cost, and schedule performance. This
